scope: Representative common six-joint FPGA/ESP motion and I/O core only. Reference component pricing, not a qualified circuit, production BOM, distributor quote or complete product cost.
quantity_semantics: All offer breaks are COMPONENT PIECES, not completed controllers. Procurement demand = quantity_per_controller times controller build quantity. Aggregate repeated MPNs (ISO7740FDBQR totals six per controller) before applying tiers. Full-reel prices require listed packaging/MOQ/multiples; excluded packaging/setup fees must be added if used. Missing breaks are not invented.
circuit_assumptions: Six STEP/DIR joints using12 differential TX channels; two A/B/index feedback ports using6 RX channels.
22 isolated nominal24 V field inputs;14 nominal24 V sourcing protected outputs (8general +6enables). Four quad power devices fit16channels but only14are allocated.
Output isolation and fault returns are budgeted explicitly; STEP/DIR and encoder interfaces are NOT galvanically isolated in this reference.
Input ISO1212 devices already include isolation and do not require an isolated field-side supply for the input receiver itself.

Separate isolated spindle analog domain uses DAC plus gain amplifier and dedicated12 V isolated DC/DC. This is a relatively complete, higher-accuracy reference approach; filteredPWM could differ in cost and performance.
96field positions and96matching plug contacts are budgeted using12eight-way connector pairs.22positions above the74signal/reference minimum are a provisional allowance, not a final wiring map.

Low-voltage buck/LDO ICs are provisional onboard rail references. Parent costing adds controller/display PSU, common input conversion/protection, cooling, assembly, tariffs and finished product hardware.
System isolation depends on final power and ground architecture. Common return or external cables must not bypass intended barriers. This file does not include a proven isolated core power tree.
scope_expansions_not_original_requiremen: Five dedicated digital isolators for14output commands and four aggregate bank fault returns.
One-per-input TVS component provision; final clamping arrangement and count are unresolved.
16-bit DAC with isolated supply rather than cheaper unqualified PWM spindle conversion.
All six enable channels costed using the same smart high-side switch family as general outputs.

component_lines.electrical_scope: T20 reference FPGA in 256-ball package only; no package-fit, bank-voltage, gateware timing or temperature qualification.
unknowns: Separate rail/clock/configuration-storage/debug support remains incomplete.
Do not assume package-integrated configuration flash.
Any higher-volume use of $12.75 is a flat reference assumption, not a quoted volume price.

component_lines.electrical_scope: PCB-antenna module with 8 MB flash; auxiliary services, not CAD application compute.
unknowns: Power switching, decoupling, boot/reset, service connector and antenna-enclosure clearance not included.
Do not price additional flash already supplied by this module.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Four 5 V-supply differential drivers per IC; three ICs provide 12 STEP/DIR transmit channels. TTL-compatible control-level suitability must be checked against final FPGA bank.
unknowns: This line has no galvanic isolation for STEP/DIR.
Termination/output protection, connector reference paths, enable defaults and timing skew require design.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Quad 3.3 V differential receiver; two ICs provide eight receivers, of which six implement two A/B/index encoders.
unknowns: Two fitted receiver channels are spare, not six extra encoder axes.
No galvanic isolation on encoder signals in this reference.
Termination, surge/ESD network and supplied encoder power/filter/protection remain unpriced.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Dual isolated industrial digital-input receiver; 11 ICs provide 16 general plus six drive-alarm inputs. Reference is 24 V field sensing with correctly sized external threshold/current-setting resistors.

offers.availability_snapshot: 27832 shown on canonical result; 9-week lead-time indication

offers.evidence_note: Canonical page opened on research date; stale search/image URLs showed lower different prices and were not used.

unknowns: Do not add 22 optocouplers or another 22-channel digital-isolation line: the receiver already contains isolation.
Input threshold/series resistors, RC filters, capacitors and actual surge topology remain unpriced.
Probe/toolsetter filter and timestamp latency need separate validation.
No field-side isolated DC/DC is required just for these input receivers; system grounding must still preserve the intended barrier.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Littelfuse TVS reference provision: budget one per input as a conservative component-count assumption, not a validated final clamp topology. Part appears in TI ISO1212 EVM BOM; final network/count may differ.
unknowns: Clamping residual voltage/current, resistor energy, reverse-input behavior and surge target must be calculated.
This 36 V standoff part is not proposed for 5 V signal ports or 40 V output-IC supply protection.
One-per-input is an expanded budget provision; the selected EVM uses a different shared arrangement and does not validate this quantity.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Quad smart high-side switch; four ICs provide 16 fitted channels, 14 used for eight general outputs and six individual enables. Nominal 24 V sourcing only; not arbitrary-voltage dry contacts. Includes current limiting, thermal protection and internal inductive clamp functions within datasheet limits.

offers.evidence_note: Canonical page opened; older SEO/image-page prices were materially lower and not used.

unknowns: 14 enable/output loads are not defined; per-channel current and total-bank thermal limits remain unknown.
External current-limit resistors, supply transient/reverse protection and load-dependent clamps remain unpriced.
B version has bank fault indication and multiplexed current sense; detailed ADC current telemetry and channel selection circuitry are not included.
This is a robust costing choice; a low-current enable channel need not ultimately use the same power IC as a general load.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Five quad one-direction isolators: four oriented logic-to-field for 16 command channels (14 used), one oriented field-to-logic for four aggregate bank-fault signals. F default-low behavior is useful for command inhibits, subject to complete reset design.
unknowns: Requires field-side logic supply and a power/ground architecture that does not bridge this isolation.
Separate from the ISO1212 inputs; not another charge for input isolation.
Bank-fault receiver polarity/logic and inhibit gating need final verification.
Detailed current telemetry is not carried by these four fault-return channels.

component_lines.electrical_scope: 16-bit single-channel voltage DAC with integrated reference; zero-scale-reset variant. Configured for internal 2.5 V reference at gain 1 (0-2.5 V range) followed by a gain-four amplifier; a 0-5 V range cannot reach full scale below the 5 V analog rail minimum.
unknowns: Do not also add a separate voltage reference unless actual accuracy/noise design calls for one.
SPI chosen for reference; interface, analog output accuracy/settling/load and update rate not qualified.
DAC alone does not produce 0-10 V.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Rail-to-rail op amp provision for gain-four 0-2.5 V to nominal 0-10 V stage on isolated 12 V rail (>=1.4 V headroom at 11.4 V rail minimum).
unknowns: Precision gain resistors, filter, output protection, forced-zero circuitry and calibration remain unpriced.
Exact zero-volt accuracy and source/sink behavior need verification with VFD input.

component_lines.electrical_scope: One additional quad isolator for SPI clock/data/chip-select plus an inhibit/control provision crossing to the separate spindle analog domain.
unknowns: Same MPN as output isolators: aggregate all six per board for procurement breaks; do not count the analog isolator twice.
No analog-output readback ADC included.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Traco isolated module reference: 18-36 V input, 12 V/83 mA output, approximately 1 W. Dedicated analog-domain supply, not the controller/display PSU.
unknowns: Separate local 5 V regulator included below for DAC/isolator side.
EMI filtering, capacitors, thermal/current margin and isolation layout remain unpriced.
Do not double-count with any later selected module already providing complete isolated spindle power.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Two 5 V LDO reference provisions: one isolated-spindle 12-to-5 V rail; one low-current field-side 5 V isolator rail from nominal24 V. These do not power the embedded computer/display.
unknowns: Field-rail transient limit must respect regulator maximum input; nominal24 V does not imply unlimited input.
LDO dissipation/quiescent current can make the field branch unsuitable; replace with a switching solution if power budget fails.
Input/output capacitors and supply protection are unpriced.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Two buck-controller IC references for provisional 5-to-3.3 V and 5-to-1.2 V local rails; not a completed FPGA/ESP power tree or 24-to-5 V input converter.

unknowns: Inductors, capacitors, feedback resistors, startup sequence, load/thermal sizing and any additional FPGA rails remain unpriced.
Input range does not accept24 V directly.
Main controller/display PSU and common upstream input conversion belong to parent costing; not included here.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Standalone programmable watchdog IC reference; actual useful-progress signal and output inhibit/reset arrangement remain design work.
unknowns: Voltage supervisor, latch/inhibit gates, timing capacitor, reset pullups, service power switch and status indication remain unpriced.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Twelve eight-position Same Sky 5.08 mm right-angle PCB headers. Together with matching plugs this budgets96 positions:74 required signal/reference plus22 provisional commons/power/spare positions.
unknowns: Exact group sizes/keying, commons/power currents, board-edge length and shield contacts not yet allocated.
The96 allowance is not proof every power/shield/service connector fits.
USB, Ethernet, display, expansion, compute-module sockets and internal harnesses excluded.

component_lines.electrical_scope: Twelve matching eight-position Same Sky plug connectors with screw terminals. Cost includes supplied mating plugs, not just board headers.
unknowns: Wire, ferrules, labels, strain relief, enclosure connector access and labor excluded.
Use selected family mating guide and drawings before release; electrical connector rating is not board voltage rating.
